output.brief: The Kestria buffering is not mainly the CDN, the handball launch, or ISP congestion. It is the smart-TV app 5.2 playing on Tessaline. Tessaline serves every Kestria client, but only smart-TV 5.2 is stalling (5.9% rebuffering against about 0.6-0.7% for everything else on the same ISPs). Smart-TV 5.1 with auto-update off is normal on the same CDN, and handball nights were flat. The app 5.2 rollout starts the timing on 9 October, and the CDN cutover happened the same day, so the timing alone does not separate them. The client split is the strongest evidence. I am fairly confident (about 80%) in this, but I did not check the rollout configuration or the cutover log, so the exact cause inside 5.2 is unknown. Next: revert smart-TV 5.2 adaptive-streaming to the 5.1 settings and pause the wider 5.2 rollout. Do not withhold Tessaline's fees or send a breach notice on this evidence. Keep the Kestria alert on. Do not offer refunds on the assumption that buffering drove cancellations; that link is not yet shown. Adding app and device breakdowns to the dashboard is worthwhile but takes about six weeks.
